thread:
cust_acme: we're seeing random invalid JSON from /v1/generate in structured mode, errors started 03/16 evening UTC. Example payloads attached.

support_alex: sorry to hear that — can you paste a raw response that failed to parse?

cust_acme: sample:
```
{"rows": [{"uid":"u1","attrs":{"name":"Sam"}}, {"uid":"u2","attrs":{"name":"Lee"}}
{"uid":"u3","attrs":{"name":"Kim"}}]
```
(missing comma and looks like another record got spliced in)

support_alex: thanks. Any custom session reuse? streaming=false, using pooled connections?

cust_acme: yes single long-lived session token and conn pool, batch_size=50, batch_window_ms=8, structured_schema header set.

eng_rita: ack. Can you send request IDs and a time window? We'll scan logs for pool reuse and concurrency.

cust_acme: attached headers: X-Req-Id: rq-9b2c... series between 2026-03-16T22:42:10Z and 22:54:00Z.

sre_marcus: noticed a spike in batch coalescing on worker-pool-7 around 22:40 and a minor restart at 22:31. Running a quick canary repro.

eng_rita: quick hypothesis: KV/prefix cache frames were not namespaced by session_uuid; when multiple inflight requests hit the same cache shard, race writes can concatenate fragments. Structured JSON output doesn't tolerate interleaved frames.

support_alex: can you reproduce locally? Our customer needs a hotfix ASAP.

eng_rita: repro steps that hit it reliably:
1) spawn 16 concurrent threads reusing same session token
2) set batch_size >=48 and batch_window_ms <=10
3) send structured_json prompts with similar prefixes
Result: ~1-2% responses have merged JSON fragments within a minute.

sre_marcus: confirmed on canary with batch_size=64. Tracing shows overlapping KV write/flush order.

eng_rita: short mitigation: disable prefix/KV caching for structured mode and any session with X-Structured-Schema:true. Also temporarily lower default batch_size on affected pools to 8.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rita/kvcache-hotfix -> pool-07 (canary)

eng_rita: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/kvcache/+/PR-4835 — changes: include request_uuid in cache key, atomic frame writes, unit test for concurrent structured output.

prod_emma: support, please notify affected customers and offer credits for failed ingestion windows. Recommend clients rotate long-lived session tokens.

support_alex: messaging going out. Also asking customers to set streaming=true as workaround? any impact?

eng_rita: streaming avoids some batching paths, but not a silver bullet. Better to disable the prefix cache for structured mode until patch.

sre_marcus: rolling env var DISABLE_PREFIX_CACHE_STRUCT=true across pool-05..08. Monitoring.

support_alex: Acme confirmed parsing passes after restart of their client and our server change. Filing postmortem and follow-ups.

eng_rita: postmortem action items: 1) add session_uuid to cache key 2) block prefix cache when X-Structured-Schema:true unless strict isolation 3) add chaos e2e for pooled structured_json 4) alert when parse error rate >0.1%.

support_alex: marking resolved for now. Will update when PR fully rolled.
